posts.t: How Long Does Exterior Paint Last on a Cape Cod Home?
posts.d: A good paint job on wood siding often lasts 7 to 10 years. Learn what shortens it on Cape Cod, how often to repaint, and the signs it is time.

posts.t: When Is the Best Time to Paint a House Exterior on Cape Cod?
posts.d: On Cape Cod, the dependable window for exterior paint runs from late May through September. See the temperatures, dew rules and data behind it.
